# Claude Platform release notes — captured 2026-08-21
# Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api
# (the two sources.json Anthropic URLs still 404 — see errors table)

### August 19, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN. Eight items in one entry; six reported.
- **Computer use tool GA** as `computer_toolset_20260801`: no beta header, BATCH ACTIONS (several
  actions in one turn), `zoom` enabled by default, per-member configuration via `configs`. Earlier
  beta versions remain. Upgrading changes request shape + tool handling (migrate from
  `computer_20251124`).                                            [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- **NEW: browser use tool** `browser_toolset_20260801` — client toolset driving a browser the
  APPLICATION hosts; works in a viewport, not a whole desktop. Reads the page ACCESSIBILITY TREE.
    read_page  -> a11y tree as text w/ stable refs [ref_1], [ref_2]...; Claude acts BY REFERENCE
    find       -> locate elements from natural-language description
    get_page_text -> visible text
    navigate (+back/forward/reload), screenshot, zoom
    pointer: left/right/middle/double/triple_click, hover, scroll, scroll_to, left_click_drag,
             left_mouse_down/up, mouse_move
    keyboard: type, key (chords), hold_key, wait ; forms: form_input
    tabs: new_tab, list_tabs, switch_tab, close_tab
  OPTIONAL members, DISABLED BY DEFAULT: **javascript_exec, file_upload, read_console, read_network**
  file_upload targets <input type="file"> from executor `paths` OR app-staged `document_ids`.
  App must report tabs via `browser_state` blocks and downloads via `state_changes`
  (download_started/completed/failed). target = {type:"ref"} or {type:"coordinate"} (viewport px).
  Batch semantics: run sequentially, STOP AT FIRST FAILURE, answer the rest is_error.
  Anthropic's own guidance: dedicated container, no credentials, network-layer domain allowlist,
  refuse javascript:/file:/data:/chrome:, treat ALL page content as untrusted + sanitize titles/URLs,
  redact secrets before enabling console/network, human confirmation for consequential actions.
  Leads with PROMPT INJECTION RISK.                                [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH/AIRT]
- Both toolsets available on Claude Fable 5, **Claude Mythos 5**, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Opus 4.8.
- **Files API GA** — `/v1/files` no longer needs `files-api-2025-04-14`. GA format adds
  `expires_in_seconds` / `expires_at` and page/next_page pagination + `ids[]` filter.  [held]
- **Agent Skills + Skills API (`/v1/skills`) GA** — no `skills-2025-10-02` header, incl. Messages API
  requests loading Skills via the `container` parameter.            [reported 2026-08-21, HIGH]
- **Admin API user management GA for Claude Enterprise** (claude.ai orgs): members, invites, GROUPS,
  CUSTOM ROLES. `ce-user-management-2026-07-13` header no longer required. [reported 2026-08-21, MED]
- **web_search / web_fetch domain restriction** on Managed Agents: `allowed_domains` /
  `blocked_domains` per-tool in the `agent_toolset_20260401` `configs` array. web_fetch also
  `max_content_tokens`; web_search also `user_location`. configs entries keyed by `name`, optional
  `type`; old {name, enabled, permission_policy} shape still works. [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- **Memory stores attachable to SELF-HOSTED sandboxes** — Python/TS/Go SDK workers DOWNLOAD each
  attached store into the sandbox at its `mount_path` and SYNC THE AGENT'S CHANGES BACK.
                                                                    [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM]
- Console session viewer redesigned: timeline minimap, transcript grouped by model request,
  Inspector panel (session details, cost, raw events, per-tool stats, mounted resources,
  per-thread activity).                                              [held — observability UI]

### August 18, 2026 — NEW THIS SCAN
- Workbench is now **Playground** in the Claude Console; supports every Messages API parameter,
  templates for code execution / web search, shows full SDK request + API response.  [held — rename]

### August 11, 2026  (both reported 2026-08-14)
- Compliance API returns transcripts of LOCAL sessions (Cowork + Claude Code on users' machines).
  GET /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local[/{id}][/messages], `clls_` IDs, existing Compliance Access
  Key + `read:compliance_user_data`. Admin API keys 403. product_surface = cowork | claude_code.
  Transcript = prompts, assistant text, tool_use/tool_result (MCP normalized in). NOT returned:
  thinking, system prompt, **tool definitions + MCP server configuration**, binary blocks.
  Blind spots: Console API key; **Bedrock / Google Cloud / Microsoft Foundry routing**; Claude Code
  on web; HIPAA-readiness orgs; ZDR; CMEK (lists, content withheld).
- `anthropic-workspace-id` response header (`wrkspc_` prefix, incl. Default Workspace).

### August 10 / 7 / 5 / 3 / 1, 2026 — unchanged, all previously reported
Sonnet 5 pricing (pricing, not reported); Managed Agents session budgets + advisor + `inference_geo`
+ skills from a mounted GitHub repo's `.claude/skills`; inference hooks beta + Opus 4.1 retired;
Compliance API REMOTE Cowork sessions (`cse_`, agent-owned sessions have `agent_id` = `cagt_`);
Dreams supports Opus 5.

### WATCH ITEM — never reported by this monitor
**Claude Mythos 5** (`claude-mythos-5`) — launched alongside Claude Fable 5 for **Project Glasswing**
participants (invitation-only gated research preview for DEFENSIVE CYBERSECURITY work). 1M context,
128k output, always-on adaptive thinking (`thinking:{"type":"disabled"}` unsupported, no manual
budgets, no assistant prefill — both 400). Access was "restored" per a dated entry
(anthropic.com/news/redeploying-fable-5). A gated cyber-capable model tier is the direct analogue of
OpenAI's Daybreak Red / GPT-5.6-Cyber finding (reported 2026-08-14). **Chase next scan.**

Standing coverage note: keep watching /docs/en/managed-agents/* and /docs/en/manage-claude/*.

Updated: 2026-08-21 — TWO new dated entries (Aug 18, Aug 19). The Aug 19 entry is the largest
single Anthropic release entry this monitor has recorded; the browser use toolset is the headline.
